Name: Simeon
Summary: Simeon was a righteous and devout man in Jerusalem who had been promised he would not die before seeing the Messiah. Led by the Spirit, he held baby Jesus in the Temple and blessed God.
KeyStory: Simeon took Jesus in his arms and sang, My eyes have seen Your salvation, calling Him a light for revelation to the Gentiles.
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Anna the Prophetess; Mary, Mother of Jesus
LifeLesson: Simeon waited a lifetime and held his promise in his arms. Keep waiting on God in His house — the promise-keeper lets His faithful see His salvation.
